notes.title: Alchemy release!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! Alchemy has officially been released! We hope you can enjoy it as much as we enjoyed the process of iterating this puzzle game. But this is not the end, there are some things that must be clarified.


 There is no controller or steam deck support at the moment, but it will be eventually added.  The next patch for the game will probably be delayed ay least a month, but it will eventually come, so feel free to discuss any important feedback!
 We will not focus on supporting Mac or Linux devices, some feedback may be taken into account but it is just not worth for us to focus on them at the moment.
 All solutions will be posted on the YouTube channel, but it may take some time. In the meantime, everyone can discuss solutions on the forums or the discord server.
 Every kind of feedback is appreciated so do not hesitate to contact us or leave a good review if you liked anything :).



Thank you for playing,
-The Default Company
